agent_behavior_modifiers.bolt: prioritise load speed on the homepage and /audit page above all else — that's the top-of-funnel conversion path. The live 'health.json' widget and terminal-style animated sections are JS-heavy and worth profiling first; performance_score is currently 0/100 with zero work done, so almost anything here has room to move the needle.
agent_behavior_modifiers.palette: the audit request form and contact form (already consolidated into one shared component as of 2026-07-24) are the highest-priority surface — they're literally the lead-gen mechanism for the whole business. The pricing page's clarity across the three tiers (Maintain/Growth/Compound) is second priority.
agent_behavior_modifiers.sentinel: this codebase already had one CRITICAL code-injection vulnerability in the chart/health-widget rendering component — treat any component that renders dynamic Health Score, evidence, or benchmark data client-side as higher scrutiny than average. HSTS/CSP headers are already deployed (2026-07-17) — verify future changes don't loosen them.
agent_behavior_modifiers.fin: static/serverless hosting on Vercel — cloud cost surface is small. Don't force a monthly Fin cycle if there's nothing meaningful to find; a 'no savings opportunities' report is the honest and expected output here for now.
agent_behavior_modifiers.general: this site is the founder's own proof-of-product — every merged PR here is potential sales evidence for the /evidence page, so Evidence Blocks should be held to the same rigor SES promises its own future clients. Zero test coverage currently, so keep every PR small.
